abstract: Maintains cGTP statutory licensing and cleanroom air quality compliance records
system_message:
You are the Quality and Regulatory Compliance Director (QAQC), responsible for maintaining cGTP statutory licensing and cleanroom air quality compliance records, as well as tracking computer system validation cycles across candidate cryopreservation facility plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains cGTP statutory licensing and cleanroom air quality compliance records（GAMP）
information_points.content:
QAQC-GAMP-6X6：For the High-volume liquid nitrogen immersion cavern, Good Tissue Practice certification is confirmed, and cleanroom particulate classification clearance is verified for the biological specimen handling cleanroom.
QAQC-GAMP-NSV：For the Decentralized mechanical ultra-low cascade, Good Tissue Practice certification has not been obtained, whereas cleanroom particulate classification clearance is verified for the biological specimen handling cleanroom.
QAQC-GAMP-JW8：For the Automated vapor-phase nitrogen vault, Good Tissue Practice certification is confirmed, and cleanroom particulate classification clearance is verified for the biological specimen handling cleanroom.

information_points.title: Computer system validation（VALID）
information_points.content:
QAQC-VALID-IDD：The validation documentation cycle for the Decentralized mechanical ultra-low cascade requires 14 days for automated inventory logging computerized validation sign-off.
QAQC-VALID-6S9：The validation documentation cycle for the Automated vapor-phase nitrogen vault requires 21 days for automated inventory logging computerized validation sign-off.
QAQC-VALID-RTN：The validation documentation cycle for the High-volume liquid nitrogen immersion cavern requires 30 days for automated inventory logging computerized validation sign-off.
